issues.reason: Quantity -> strength: the companion's absence marks the bare generic and a bare generic takes strength 0.9 ('Apples are sweet' -> (STV 0.9 0.9)), so (STV 1.0 0.9) asserts the 'all / every' strength the sentence never states.

Copular universals and generics do not reify events (they stay the single Inheritance fact of Categorical statements), and the adjective-complement rule reserves the reified-state route for an individuated bearer — so a state witness whose Experiencer is the kind symbol stored_mire_essence is unlicensed and asserts one particular state held by the kind itself.

The confidence dial reaches every kind-level claim whatever its head, so atoms encoding this empirical, counterexample-admitting generic take confidence 0.9, not the individual-fact 0.99 the state bundle carries.

gaps_confirmed: a duration on a kind-level generic property ('stays good for six months'): (Measure e duration <n> <unit>) needs an eventuality, a copular generic over a kind reifies none, and the flat Inheritance atom has no shelf-life slot

a restrictive state / participial modifier on a bare-kind (mass) generic subject ('stored mire-essence'): the compound rule bars fusing a non-classifying modifier, and ConditionalProperty — the nearest licensed carrier, (ConditionalProperty mire_essence good stored) — is cued only by a when / at / under / if clause, never by an attributive modifier
new_gaps: a continuation copular ('stays / remains P') over a KIND: the Still tag needs a reified state witness, which a kind-level copular generic does not license, so 'stays good' cannot be distinguished from plain 'is good' at kind level
defect_summary: Issue 0: the flat generic is (Inheritance stored_mire_essence good) (STV 0.9 0.9) — strength 0.9 for a quantifier-less generic. Issue 1: no licensed form exists — a kind-level copular generic reifies no state, so the state witness and its kind-filled Experiencer must go, leaving 'stays' and 'for six months' with no carrier at all (both filed as gaps). Issue 2: had any of those atoms stood they would take the empirical 0.9 confidence rather than 0.99, but the compliant move is to omit the bundle entirely.
notes: The reviewer's unfiled observation is right and belongs in the re-parse: the compound-kind rule decomposes once to the single-word head, so the genus is (Inheritance stored_mire_essence essence), not the intermediate compound mire_essence. Whether 'stored mire-essence' should have been fused at all is itself doubtful — 'stored' is a state, not a classifier that carves a subtype.
